description: This file implements a Hibernate-based Data Access Object (DAO) for managing Concept, Drug, and related entities within the OpenMRS healthcare data platform. It provides methods to retrieve, save, delete, and search concepts and their related data, leveraging Hibernate criteria queries, custom search session indexing, and UUID-based entity retrieval. The class supports comprehensive CRUD operations for concepts, drugs, reference terms, map types, and annotations related to the medical concepts catalog.

classes.name: HibernateConceptDAO
classes.description: Hibernate implementation of the ConceptDAO interface, providing CRUD operations, search capabilities, and UUID-based entity retrieval for concepts and related entities within the OpenMRS platform.

classes.name: ConceptIterator
classes.description: Inner class implementing an iterator to sequentially traverse all Concept entities in the database by conceptId.

methods.name: getConceptComplex
methods.description: Retrieves a ConceptComplex entity from the database by its conceptId, handling cache detachment if necessary.

methods.name: saveConcept
methods.description: Saves or updates a Concept entity, inserting into subclass tables (e.g., ConceptNumeric, ConceptComplex) as needed.

methods.name: getConcept
methods.description: Fetches a Concept entity by its conceptId.

methods.name: getConceptName
methods.description: Fetches a ConceptName entity by its conceptNameId.

methods.name: getAllConcepts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all concepts, optionally sorted and including/excluding retired concepts.

methods.name: saveDrug
methods.description: Saves or updates a Drug entity.

methods.name: getDrug
methods.description: Retrieves a Drug entity by its drugId.

methods.name: getDrugs
methods.description: Retrieves drugs matching name, concept, and retirement status.

methods.name: getDrugsByIngredient
methods.description: Returns drugs that contain a specific ingredient concept.

methods.name: getConceptClass
methods.description: Fetches a ConceptClass entity by its id.

methods.name: getConceptClasses
methods.description: Fetches a list of ConceptClass entities by name, optionally.

methods.name: getAllConceptClasses
methods.description: Retrieves all ConceptClasses, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: saveConceptClass
methods.description: Saves or updates a ConceptClass entity.

methods.name: purgeConcept
methods.description: Deletes a Concept entity from the database.

methods.name: purgeDrug
methods.description: Deletes a Drug entity from the database.

methods.name: saveConceptProposal
methods.description: Saves or updates a concept proposal record.

methods.name: getAllConceptProposals
methods.description: Retrieves all concept proposals, filtered by completion state.

methods.name: getConceptProposal
methods.description: Fetches a concept proposal by its ID.

methods.name: getProposedConcepts
methods.description: Retrieves concepts proposed with a specific original text.

methods.name: getConceptSetsByConcept
methods.description: Returns concept sets where the provided concept is part of the set.

methods.name: getParents
methods.description: Recursively retrieves parent concepts related to the current concept in set hierarchies.

methods.name: getConceptsByAnswer
methods.description: Fetches concepts that are answers to the specified concept.

methods.name: getConceptUuids
methods.description: Returns a map of conceptId to UUID for all concepts.

methods.name: getConceptByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a concept by its UUID.

methods.name: saveConceptStopWord
methods.description: Saves or updates a ConceptStopWord, preventing duplicates.

methods.name: getConceptStopWords
methods.description: Gets stop words for concept analysis in a specific locale.

methods.name: getConceptReferenceTerms
methods.description: Lists concept reference terms, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: getConceptReferenceTermByName
methods.description: Finds a concept reference term by its name and source, raising exception if multiple are found.

methods.name: getConceptReferenceTermByCode
methods.description: Finds a concept reference term by code and source, with filtering for retired status.

methods.name: saveConceptReferenceTerm
methods.description: Inserts or updates a concept reference term.

methods.name: getReferenceTermMappingsTo
methods.description: Retrieves mappings pointing to a specific concept reference term.

methods.name: saveConceptReferenceRange
methods.description: Saves or updates a ConceptReferenceRange entity.

methods.name: getConceptReferenceRangesByConceptId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ConceptReferenceRange for a given concept ID.

methods.name: getConceptReferenceRangeByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a ConceptReferenceRange by UUID.

methods.name: purgeConceptReferenceRange
methods.description: Deletes a ConceptReferenceRange entity from the database.
